hypothesised_pattern: The base model misses a symmetric quadratic (U-shaped) effect of x4, underpredicting when |x4| is large and overpredicting when x4 is near zero.
rationale: The four positive residuals (+0.26 to +0.27) all have |x4| between 1.25 and 1.74 with both signs (+1.357 and -1.741), whereas the six negative residuals (about -0.26) all have |x4| at most 0.43. Large |x5| shows up in both the positive and negative groups, so x5 does not separate them, while an even function of x4 does.
